messages:
Maya Patel: FYI: incident in eu-controlplane → ingress 503s. Putting today's 16:00 release window on hold. Deploybot will pause canaries. Need decision on rollback vs quarantine + pin. @Jordan Hsu, can you confirm service health?

DeployBot: DeployBot: Canary rollouts paused for release v2026.03.21-rc4. Reason: incident:europe-controlplane-ingress-503. All pending slots frozen.

Jordan Hsu: Looking into metrics now. CPU high on controlplane pods, not yet widespread. We'll have canary metrics in 5m.

Keira Nolan: If we rollback, what's the fallout? Any DB migrations in rc4? @Samir Khan

Samir Khan: No DB migrations in rc4. It's config and runtime kernel tweak for kvcache. Safe to rollback, but we lose config fixes. Prefer pin current stable and rerun canaries once controlplane clears.

OpsBot: OpsBot: Incident created INC-2026-042. Pager notified. Incident lead: Jordan Hsu.

Maya Patel: Agree with Samir. Let's pin prod to v2026.03.18 (stable) and schedule a staggered requeue when incident is resolved. Can we update release notes and inform PMs?

Jordan Hsu: Confirming controlplane CPU spike is related to a kernel selection regress on new infra; rolling back should restore baseline within 2m. Recommend soft rollback of the canaries now.

Maya Patel: Ok execute rollback for canaries only. Don't touch queued slots. @DeployBot please rollback canary slots for v2026.03.21-rc4 -> v2026.03.18, keep release window reserved but mark blocked.

DeployBot: DeployBot: Initiating canary rollback... Step1: stop canary traffic -> completed. Step2: redeploying replicas to v2026.03.18 -> in progress.

Keira Nolan: I'll update release notes /changelog noting incident hold and partial rollback. Add section: 'Blocked: 16:00 window — reschedule pending incident clearance'.

Samir Khan: Also add rollback rationale and rollback steps in the notes, plus a note to devs to cherry-pick config tweak into next RC.

Jordan Hsu: Monitoring... metrics trending back to baseline. Will keep observation for 10m.

Maya Patel: Plan for reschedule: propose new window Thurs 10:00 UTC (canary+staircase). If incident unresolved, fallback to next week. Ops, speak now if conflicts.

Keira Nolan: Thumbs up from PM. I'll send calendar invite tentative. Also add RELEASE_NOTE: pin:prod=v2026.03.18; blocked_release=v2026.03.21-rc4.

OpsBot: OpsBot: Change window updated to BLOCKED. Incident INC-2026-042 is assigned. Next update in 15m.

Jordan Hsu: Canaries rolled back successfully. Services restored. Monitoring continues.

Maya Patel: Thanks all. Will follow up with incident postmortem and final reschedule once incident is closed. :white_check_mark:
